Featured · 01 · Support

Managed IT & Support

This is the service most clients start with: a single team that watches your devices, your network, and your cloud environment, and steps in before a small issue becomes downtime. We run the help desk, we own the monitoring dashboards, and we're the first call when something breaks.

In practice that covers day-to-day user support across laptops, desktops, and mobile devices; onboarding and offboarding staff with the right access from day one; patching and security updates on a schedule, not an afterthought; and proactive monitoring of servers, endpoints, and cloud accounts so alerts get caught by us, not reported by your team.

Same-day response Remote + on-site Proactive monitoring Device & user lifecycle
Featured · 02 · Web

Website Management

We design, build, and maintain the website your business runs on — not a one-time project that goes stale, but an asset we keep fast, secure, and current for as long as you work with us.

That means hosting and uptime monitoring, security patching and SSL management, content and copy updates whenever your business changes, and performance tuning so the site stays quick on any device. Need a new site from scratch, or a redesign of what you already have? We scope and build that too.

Design & build Hosting & uptime Security & SSL Ongoing content updates
Featured · 03 · MS365

Microsoft 365 Administration

We set up and run your Microsoft 365 environment end-to-end — Teams, Exchange, SharePoint, and OneDrive configured to match how your business actually works, not just the defaults.

That covers user provisioning and license management, security policy and multi-factor authentication, mailbox and storage administration, and hands-on training so your team actually uses what you're paying for. When new hires join or roles change, access changes go out the same day.

Setup & migration License management Security policy Team training
Featured · 04 · Build

Custom Application Development

When an off-the-shelf tool doesn't fit how your business runs, we design and build software that does — internal tools, client-facing platforms, and the integrations that connect them to the systems you already use.

We start with how your team actually works, wireframe and prototype before writing a line of production code, then build, test, and ship in stages so you see progress early and often. Once it's live, we keep maintaining and extending it as your needs change.

Wireframing & UX Web & mobile apps System integrations Ongoing maintenance
Featured · 05 · Network

Network Management

Your network is the thing nobody notices until it stops working. We monitor, maintain, and support the switches, routers, and infrastructure that keep your offices and cloud systems connected.

That includes 24/7 uptime monitoring with alerts before problems become outages, firmware and security patching, bandwidth and performance management as your team grows, and hands-on troubleshooting whenever something needs a physical fix.

24/7 monitoring Patching & updates Performance tuning On-site troubleshooting
Featured · 06 · Advise

Tech Consulting

Before you invest in new infrastructure or rebuild what you have, talk to us. We advise on architecture, security posture, and technology strategy so the next phase of your stack is built on a plan, not guesswork.

That covers network and systems architecture reviews, security audits and risk assessments, technology roadmaps tied to your growth plans, and vendor-neutral recommendations — we tell you what you actually need, not what's easiest for us to sell.

Architecture review Security audits Technology roadmaps Vendor-neutral advice

About YakHive

Strong together, by design.

YakHive was built on a simple idea: a yak carries what a team can't carry alone, and a hive gets more done together than any single bee ever could. That's the model we run on — a small, hands-on technology team that works as an extension of yours, not a vendor at the end of an email chain.

We combine managed IT support, Microsoft 365 administration, custom software development, and network engineering under one roof, so mid-market and enterprise teams get a single accountable partner instead of a rotating cast of contractors.

Based in Kathmandu, Nepal, and built to work the way modern teams do — remote-first, responsive, and close to the work.

ReliabilitySystems that work quietly in the background, and people who answer when they don't.
PartnershipWe work inside your priorities, not around them.
CraftBuilt properly the first time — not patched together to ship fast.
SecurityEvery system treated as if it were holding something worth protecting, because it is.

"Strong Together" isn't a slogan we picked — it's the org chart. Every engagement runs through the same small team, so accountability never gets diluted.
